model_annotation: This plot illustrates the share of employed persons across different ages for four demographic groups. The x-axis is labeled "Alter" and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Anteil Erwerbstätige in %" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20. The plot contains four solid lines, all featuring small circular markers. The black line, representing "ohne Migrationshintergrund," starts at an age of 20 with a value of approximately 60%, rises steadily to about 82% at age 25, maintains a high plateau with a peak of roughly 89% at age 45, and then declines sharply after age 60 to end at approximately 5% at age 70. The grey line, representing "in Deutschland geboren," begins at age 20 at roughly 54%, exhibits a fluctuating upward trend to peak at approximately 88% at age 50, with notable dips to 67% at age 33 and 72% at age 54, before declining sharply after age 60 to end at about 8% at age 70. The light blue line, representing "zugewandert bis 2009," starts at age 20 at approximately 35%, spikes to 77% at age 21, fluctuates generally between 60% and 75% through the middle ages, and drops steeply after age 60 to finish at roughly 10% at age 70. The dark blue line, representing "zugewandert seit 2010," begins at age 20 at about 38% and displays high volatility across the x-axis, featuring peaks such as 69% at age 51 and 70% at age 57, alongside sharp drops such as 38% at age 53 and 36% at age 61, before falling to 0% at age 67, briefly spiking to 25% at age 68, and ending at 0% at age 70.
